title: Global Director, Supplier Quality
text:
**Job Title:** Global Director, Supplier Quality

**Job Location:** Southfield, MI

**What we offer:**

VeoneerSafety Systemsis the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.
 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth*.* 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

**What you'll do:**

The Global Director of Supplier Quality leads the global SQ organization, setting strategy, standards, and accountability for supplier readiness, performance, and continuous improvement.

The role combines global Supplier Quality leadership (80%) with North America Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leadership (20%).

**Key Responsibilities for Supplier Quality** (80% of role)

**Strategic Leadership & Global Deployment**

* Set global SQ strategy aligned with corporate, customer, sourcing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Define and execution of Supplier Quality Policies, Standards, Processes, Methods and Systems.
* Owner of Veoneer Supplier Manual (VSM), Supplier Quality Project (SQP) – APQP & PPAP, Supplier Non-Conformance Material (NCM) Management.
* Align cross-functional priorities, resources, and accountability; establish SQE oversight of workload, open issues, owners, overdue actions, and escalations.
* Monitor supplier quality targets, initiatives and indicators to ensure compliance to Veoneer Supplier Quality related policies, standards and reporting.

**Supplier Development & Standards Compliance**

* Oversee new supplier assessment, qualification, and development with Purchasing and Engineering; improve assessment models and ensure teams close risks and capability gaps before sourcing and production approval.
* Set common supplier requirements, risk-based audit and development expectations, and change controls; ensure existing suppliers improve capability and sustain company and customer compliance.
* Representing quality in Supplier Sourcing Board.

**Supplier Performance & Major Quality Issues**

* Lead major supplier escalations with supplier executives and cross-functional teams, ensuring containment, exposure assessment, production and customer protection, and verified permanent corrective actions.
* Drive common KPIs and improvement targets for supplier PPM, repeat defects, corrective-action aging, disruptions.
* Require leadership reviews and improvement plans for systemic issues, sharing lessons learned across suppliers.
* Supplier Scorecard (VS051 rating) and drive continuous improvement for supplier quality performance.

**Supplier APQP / PPAP & Safe Launch**

* Ensure on time and effective supplier APQP, PPAP, and Safe Launch for new programs, suppliers, and changes, including risk reviews, capability verification, and readiness-gap closure before production release.

**Quality Tools, Talent Development & Training**

* Set expectations for consistent SQE application of core quality tools, process audits, and structured problem solving to strengthen prevention and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Assess global SQ team capabilities and set development priorities with regional managers to strengthen technical expertise, expand skills, and build future leaders through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Supplier Quality talent review and succession plan.

**Regional Leadership: Engineering Quality & Operational Quality** (20% of role)

* Represent Quality Leadership team in regional activities across RDE, Manufacturing and Supplier Quality teams.
* Align regional priorities, governance, performance reviews, and escalations with global Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leaders and standards.
* Guide development and launch readiness, quality system execution, major issue resolution, and lessons learned while retaining local execution accountability.

**What you'll bring:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering.

**Experience:** Minimum 15 years in supplier quality, including supplier qualification, development, major issue resolution, and talent development. Electronics experience required; automotive SQ experience strongly preferred. Experience leading a multinational organization is preferred.

**Skills:**

* Global SQ leadership and effective matrix-team management.
* Cross-functional influence, supplier executive engagement, and timely decision-making.
* Strong supplier APQP, PPAP, change management, and Safe Launch knowledge.
* Advanced PFMEA, control plan, MSA, SPC, capability, audit, and 8D expertise; proven data-driven problem resolution and daily management.
* Strong commodity expertise for IC, PCB and/or mechanical parts is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Experience in other Quality domains is preferred

**Location:** Physical location Markham, Ontario, Canada or Southfield, Michigan; global scope across North America, Europe, India, and Asia.

**Travel:** International travel will be required 8-10 times per year.

**Reporting / Collaboration:**

* Reports to SVP Manufacturing & Quality.
* Solid-line responsibility for tech-center SQEs; dotted-line functional leadership of plant SQEs, with plant leadership retaining local operational accountability.
* Partners with Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, Industrialization, Program Management, and supplier leadership.
